target_claim: Rank and percentage rules produce measurably different eliminations and fan influence under the same plausible votes.

leakage_risks: final placement cannot determine weekly counterfactuals
data_audit.missingness_notes: Only Q1-current active rosters and supported elimination weeks enter comparison.

baseline.name: deterministic point replay
baseline.reason: directly implements both published combination formulas
baseline.validation: replay consistency and hand-checked official appendix examples

candidates.name: uncertainty-integrated counterfactual replay
candidates.formulation: Apply rank and percentage rules to every feasible/bootstrap Q1 vote draw and summarize disagreement and fan-favor metrics with intervals.
assumptions: fan response is fixed under a counterfactual weekly rule
tie handling is common across rules
refutation_evidence: rule recommendation reverses in more than 25% of feasible draws
candidates.decision_reason: Propagates the central Q1 uncertainty into every comparison instead of treating one latent vector as truth.

candidates.name: deterministic maximum-entropy replay
candidates.formulation: Apply both rules once to Q1 maximum-entropy point estimates.
assumptions: point estimate is adequate for directional comparison
candidates.decision_reason: Simple and reproducible when vote sampling fails, but conclusions must be weakened.

candidates.name: final-placement-only rule comparison
candidates.formulation: Infer weekly rule quality from final season placement.
assumptions: final placement is an unbiased weekly outcome label
refutation_evidence: uses future outcome to evaluate prior weeks
candidates.decision_reason: Final placement occurs after the weekly decisions and leaks the future.

stop_conditions: official combination formula unit test fails
